name: a timed round
describe: Everyone plays at once in one timed round: lobby, countdown, play, results, play again.
pick: things move all the time and every player acts at the same moment; one clock for everyone, then a winner
ends: the clock, or the rules' check naming winners

hooks.name: roundStart
hooks.when: the round starts (the same moment for everyone)

hooks.name: check
hooks.when: ten times a second: is the round over before the clock?

hooks.name: results
hooks.when: the round ended: the rows of the results card

notes: Everyone acts at once for round.seconds; the most points wins unless check(ctx) names winners sooner.
promise: A round can be won or lost, ends on a results screen, and plays again.
